t: Free drawing software for children with sound effects and a penguin guide.
steps: Download the installer from the Tux Paint site.
Ask IT to deploy it on lab computers.
Check that each computer meets the requirements, such as Windows 8 or later or macOS 10.10 or later.
Open the Tux Paint Config tool to set window size and other options.
Read the Tux Paint for schools page.
Let students try each tool for ten minutes.
Save student drawings to a shared folder.
